| Help - Choose a context                                                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
| up/down     context                                                                              |
| Enter       use                                                                                  |
| Esc         close                                                                                |
| ?/F1        help                                                                                 |
| Ctrl+C      exit                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
| Choosing a context makes it the target and runs the checks against it. dcctl never creates or    |
| deletes a context's cluster. Esc keeps the target it had. Nothing has been changed yet: nothing  |
| on these screens changes anything until you approve the plan on the review. Ctrl+C exits.        |
